description.name: Entry
description.text: Activates Ice Chain (max 150, field +50%), grants [Buff Ice 10% (5s)]/[Buff Ice 20% (5s)]/[Buff Ice 30% (5s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ allies have any [Attach Ice], grants [MAG +50% (25s)], grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (5s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%
